panels.program:
root = Card([header, excerpt, explanation], null)
header = CardHeader("Export Control Risk - NVIDIA FY2026 Report", "Item 1A. Risk Factors section, partial extract")
excerpt = TextContent("The U.S. government announced export restrictions and licensing requirements since August 2022 targeting semiconductor and supercomputing industries in China, Russia, and other regions. explanation = TextContent("In simple terms, U.S. export controls restrict NVIDIA's ability to sell certain high-performance chips and related technology to some countries.
